verifications.note: Pipeline News 'Planned Projects, In Development' listing, Oct. 2018: 'Project: Buckeye Xpress Project ... Type: Project includes pipeline replacement, looping and additional compression ... Length: 64 miles / Diameter: 36 inches / Location: Vinton, Jackson, Gallia and Laurence counties, OH; Wayne County, WV / Capacity: 275 MMcf/d' — exact match to recorded LengthKnown=64.00 mi.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded LengthKnown=64.00 mi exactly matches the Pipeline News Oct-2018 'Planned Projects' listing (already opened on this row for Capacity/Location/Proposal but not yet cited for Length) — a pre-construction industry-trade-press estimate, single source. IMPORTANT CONTRADICTION FOR VALIDITY REVIEW: every post-completion source opened on this row states a materially larger length — EIA (Mar. 2021, 'replaced 66 miles of existing natural gas pipeline with more reliable 36-inch pipe'), S&P Global Platts (Jan. 2020 FERC-approval story, 'replacement of 60.8 miles of 20- and 24-inch-diameter pipeline with about 66.1 miles of new 36-inch-diameter pipeline'), napipelines.com (Jan. 2021 in-service story, 'replacement of 66 miles of existing pipeline with ... 36-in. diameter coated pipe'), Cleveland Scene (June 2019, 'construction of 66 miles of 36-inch natural-gas pipeline to replace a 20-inch pipeline'), and Center for Biological Diversity (May 2018 press release, 'proposed 66-mile fracked-gas pipeline'). Five independent sources converge on 66 (new-pipe) / 60.8 (replaced old pipe) miles, none on 64 — this is NOT a rounding-tolerance gap (2 mi / ~3%, vs. the ~1% examples in the sweep contract) and looks like the sheet is carrying a stale pre-expansion 2018 planning figure rather than the as-built/operating length. Searched fractracker.org (National Energy and Petrochemical Map, Feb. 2020) as a possible second corroborator for either value — it does not name Buckeye Xpress at all, so it is unusable here (fails url_verifier name check) and was not proposed. No second source stating 64 mi specifically was found. Flagging LengthKnown=64.00 as likely needing correction to ~66 mi (or 60.8/66.1 split by old/new pipe) for the validity/status-review leg to adjudicate against FERC docket CP19-... records if available; this shard leaves the recorded value in place per the REFS_ADDED convention (source found that states the recorded value) rather than silently substituting a new number.
